🏠 RENT MATTERS — KNOW YOUR RIGHTS! ⚖️

Whether you are a Tenant or a Landlord, knowing your legal rights and obligations can prevent unnecessary disputes.

Some common rental issues include:

🔹 Rent increase disputes
🔹 Delay in rent payment
🔹 Maintenance & repair issues
🔹 Privacy and peaceful possession
🔹 Illegal eviction / lockout
🔹 Termination of rent agreements

A properly drafted Rent Agreement is not just paperwork—it can provide clarity and help protect both parties.

👉 Know the law. Respect the agreement. Avoid disputes.

If you're dealing with a rental or tenancy dispute, take informed legal advice before taking action.

Adv. Rohiet G. Shinde
⚖️ Legal Consultant | Advocate
📍 Thane & Bandra. 

Disclaimer: This post is for general legal awareness and does not constitute legal advice or create an attorney-client relationship.

comment: A practical point often overlooked is documenting communication around repairs, payments, and notices. Clear records can become as important as the rent agreement when disputes escalate.
